summary: Represents a valve in the game, controlling the flow of liquids or gases.  Inherits from `Workable`, meaning it can be interacted with by Duplicants. Implements `ISaveLoadable` for saving and loading game state.  This class manages the desired flow rate, interacts with the `ValveBase` component for visual and functional updates, and uses a `WorkChore` to handle Duplicant interaction.

keyMethods.name: QueuedMaxFlow
keyMethods.description: Gets the maximum flow rate queued for the valve. Returns -1 if no chore is assigned.

keyMethods.name: DesiredFlow
keyMethods.description: Gets the desired flow rate for the valve.

keyMethods.name: MaxFlow
keyMethods.description: Gets the maximum flow rate allowed by the valve's base component.

keyMethods.name: OnCopySettings
keyMethods.description: Handles copying settings from another Valve instance. Used during building duplication.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The GameObject containing the Valve to copy settings from.

keyMethods.name: OnPrefabInit
keyMethods.description: Initialization method called when the prefab is initialized. Sets up the valve's initial state, subscribes to the OnCopySettings event.

keyMethods.name: OnSpawn
keyMethods.description: Initialization method called when the valve is spawned into the game world. Sets the initial flow and adds a reference to the Prioritizable system.

keyMethods.name: OnCleanUp
keyMethods.description: Cleanup method called when the valve is removed from the game world. Removes the Prioritizable reference.

keyMethods.name: ChangeFlow
keyMethods.description: Changes the desired flow rate of the valve.  Manages the status items displayed to the player and creates or cancels the associated `WorkChore` depending on the current and desired flow rates.

keyMethods.name: OnCompleteWork
keyMethods.description: Called when a Duplicant completes work on the valve. Updates the flow rate.

parameters.name: worker
parameters.description: The Duplicant that completed the work.

keyMethods.name: UpdateFlow
keyMethods.description: Updates the valve's current flow rate to match the desired flow rate, updates animations, and removes any associated chore.

keyProperties.name: valveBase
keyProperties.description: Reference to the ValveBase component, handling the visual and physical aspects of the valve.

keyProperties.name: desiredFlow
keyProperties.description: The desired flow rate of the valve.

keyProperties.name: chore
keyProperties.description: The current work chore associated with the valve, if any.  This chore represents a Duplicant's interaction with the valve.

keyProperties.name: copyBuildingSettings
keyProperties.description: Reference to the CopyBuildingSettings component, used for duplicating the valve's settings.
